subject: organic
question: 有机化学·自由基极性：根据 Radical Learn 所采用的常见反应性分类，N-Boc-pyrrolidin-2-yl radical 通常主要表现为亲核型还是亲电型自由基？（回答该教材中的主要倾向，具体反应条件可能影响表现。）
explanation_en: Nitrogen is less electronegative than oxygen, so α-amino radicals are even more nucleophilic, and they stay so with a Boc group on nitrogen. They add to protonated heteroarenes (Minisci reactions) and are captured by nickel.
